gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-palanquin: Bruno Ace draws every stroke like a ruler-ruled pipe, stout and constant. Palanquin, a plain sans, looks light beside it, so shrinking the heading would make that gap vanish and the heading lose its punch.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-pt-sans: PT Sans, a plain sans, curls its c into a friendly open arc beneath a heading drawn with one simple, ruler-straight tip. Paragraphs in it flow along comfortably.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-quattrocento-sans: Expressive is the first word for Bruno Ace, whose round letters have rims as stout as their stems. Quattrocento Sans keeps gaps in its c so it never closes into an o, and a modest body size lets that show.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-red-hat-text: Techy, stretched and unhurried: Bruno Ace lingers on each character, its counters left open to the outside. And Red Hat Text brings the curvy, relaxed ease of a sans-serif drawn with a technical pen.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-reddit-sans: Bruno Ace sets the tone with ruler-straight lines and counters that never quite close, distinctive from the first word. And Reddit Sans keeps its e wide at the terminal, so the whole pair feels bold up top and approachable below.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-rethink-sans: Approachable describes Rethink Sans, yet Bruno Ace is the one grabbing attention with its ruler-drawn, lingering letters. Rethink Sans keeps openings generous at every weight, so enlarging it too far would crowd out the heading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-roboto-flex: Modern in feel, both of them, though Bruno Ace is far more showy, with no hairline-to-stem shifts in its line. Roboto Flex, a plain sans, counters that with a wide slot between the c's two ends, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-rosario: Contemporary and a bit quirky, Bruno Ace fills its bowls as heavily as its stems. And Rosario, a sans, lets the ends of its c stay open and never turn inward, giving the page a lighter second voice.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ruluko: Ruluko reads openly, with broad counters on its c and s that feel friendly. Bruno Ace does the loud work, its line width never swelling or tapering, while Ruluko, a sans-serif, does the quiet explaining.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-sansation: A ballpoint's plain, pressure-free line defines Bruno Ace, every glyph stretched and expressive. Sansation, a sans, avoids ink pooling where curves turn in, so a size close to the heading's would still look natural.
